open.title: Your pull requests
open.body: The project's pull requests from GitHub live one click away, without leaving lich.

filter.title: Find the one you need
filter.body: All, Ready, Drafts and Failing narrow the list, and the field above filters by number, title, author or branch. The menu next to it switches between open, closed and merged.

pick.title: Open a pull request
pick.body: Each row is a pull request with its checks and reviews.
pick.hint: Click a pull request to continue

review.title: Check it out and review it
review.body: Open in Session makes a worktree on the pull request's branch and starts a session there, or Go to session when one is already open. In Files, select lines, right-click and pick Comment on the pull request, then Add to review and Submit review.
